workflow: Set the table for four — arrangement competence in the EASE apartment
gap: set_table(covers=4: staging → dinner_for_four) under fork⊲plate, knife⊳plate, glass⌜plate, clear(serving_lane), reachable(cover,seat), sequence(plates→forks→knives→glasses)

entries.detail: Interpret the request: a dinner for four is being prepared. Task model and time horizon fixed; the target is a valued relational configuration, not a pose.

constraints.text: Target is a valued relational configuration (dinner for four), not a pose

entries.detail: Select the arrangement template dinner_for_four: required roles {plate, fork, knife, glass}, required relations, prohibitions, preferences.

constraints.text: Template dinner_for_four: roles {plate, fork, knife, glass}; 4 required relations; 2 prohibitions

entries.detail: Bind the abstract roles to available objects for each of the four seats — a sixteen-entity participant graph (4 covers × 4 roles).
Synthesize the relational configuration: fork left of plate, knife right, glass upper-right, every cover clear of the shared serving lane.

constraints.text: Relational configuration synthesized; correctness belongs to the whole

entries.detail: Ground the configuration in the semantic digital twin: admissible regions on the table surface, stable poses, reachable from each seat.

constraints.text: Grounded on table support ∩ reachable(seat); stable, collision-free poses

entries.detail: Plan the global placement order: plates first as reference frames, then forks, then knives, then glasses. An arrangement is not a bag of independent placements.

constraints.text: Global order plates→forks→knives→glasses; each placement preserves access to the rest (not a bag of independent placements)

Generated 16 real coraplex TransportAction designators grounded in an SDT World, composed into a SequentialNode plan — built, not performed (perform → simulated_robot — giskardpy motion executor + pybullet (absent in the viewer venv))

entries.detail: Place the four plates. Each plate establishes the reference frame its cover's utensils and glass are positioned against.
Place the four forks to the left of each plate (seat-relative laterality).
Place the four knives to the right of each plate.
Place the four glasses upper-right of each plate, each kept clear of the shared serving lane.

constraints.text: Glasses upper-right of plate; serving lane clear (r=0.16 m); every item reachable from its seat

entries.detail: Run the critic suite over the whole table. Local dimensions (completeness, relational, physical, convention) and global dimensions (accessibility, workflow) all pass — the configuration is admissible.

constraints.text: LOCAL — all required relations hold in every setting
LOCAL — all 4 settings complete (4 roles each)
GLOBAL — serving lane clear (r=0.16 m); every item reachable from its seat
GLOBAL — serving and clearing paths stay usable
Counterfactual: a serving object in the lane keeps every LOCAL critic green but fails GLOBAL accessibility — serving lane obstructed by shared.serving_platter

entries.detail: Commit and record the arrangement episode as tamper-evident, hash-chained evidence: template, bindings, relations and critic verdicts become NEEM.

constraints.text: Scoped arrangement competence claim — admissible=True (evidence, not proof)
